name: Series AI
tagline: AI-native game engine and platform for building games with generative AI.
description: Series AI is a generative-AI game development company building Rho Engine, an AI-native, full-stack platform that uses generative models to speed up game creation — from concept and assets through to playable builds. Founded by veteran game developer Pany Haritatos, it works with studios and IP holders to co-develop AI-native games.
insight: Founded by ex-Kongregate CEO Pany Haritatos; raised a $28M Series A from Netflix, Dell, and a16z for its AI-native Rho game engine.
edge: An AI-native game engine (Rho) built from scratch around generative models, rather than AI features bolted onto a traditional engine.

references.title: Series AI raises $7.9M in funding for game-building tools
